note: The vault's layer policy. Every path belongs to exactly one layer; the most specific pattern wins, so a narrow rule can carve an exception out of a broad one. This file is itself kernel: it changes only with a trigger word and the owner's passkey. Run code/setup/init_vault.py to set the passkey.

kernel.label: Layer 1 - the kernel: the rules every agent and person works under

docs.label: Layer 2 - documentation: the notes, written with the owner's permission

ops.label: Layer 3 - operations: agent skills, code and tooling
